item.title: Kubernetes for Haters
item.description: Kubernetes is the single most poorly understood piece of software ever created. This should perhaps be surprising given how wildly successful it is, but the truth is even more surprising: Kubernetes is misunderstood by design. I can’t account for why this would be, but the fact of it is unquestionable. The entire body of documentation along with the video-based and interpersonally delivered tutoring provided by the experts is, as far as I can tell, metaphorical.
